module: GE extension `core_onScreenKeyboard`: facade to the platform's virtual keyboards (Steam Deck, console...). It opens the keyboard with a title, an initial text, a maximum length and an input type, and relays the result to the UI via the guihooks 'onScreenKeyboardClosed'.
notes: Two types of keyboards depending on the platform (code comment): (1) 'fire and forget', which sends the keys directly to the game (Steam Deck); (2) which does not send them but returns the full text once via onScreenKeyboardClosed when the user confirms (PS5).

openOnScreenKeyboard and isOnScreenKeyboardAvailable are global functions provided by the engine; without them, opening is ignored and isOnScreenKeyboardAvailable (the Lua version) will raise an error because it calls it without checking.

openOnScreenKeyboard.desc: Opens the platform's virtual keyboard (if the engine global function exists). A non-numeric or <= 0 maxLength becomes 1000; placeholder and initialText default to '', inputType to 'string'.

textBoxLeft.desc: Left position of the text area on screen, so that the keyboard does not hide it (inferred from code).

textBoxTop.desc: Top position of the text area.

onScreenKeyboardClosed.desc: Hook called by the engine when the virtual keyboard closes: forwards to the UI (guihooks 'onScreenKeyboardClosed', applied, text).

isOnScreenKeyboardAvailable.desc: Indicates whether the platform offers a virtual keyboard (calls the engine global function of the same name).
